In triangle PQR, PQ = QR = 34 and PR = 32. The triangle is isosceles with base PR. The median QM from Q to side PR connects Q to the midpoint M of PR. In an isosceles triangle, the median to the base is also the altitude, so QM is perpendicular to PR.

Since M is the midpoint of PR, PM = MR = PR/2 = 16. Applying the Pythagorean theorem to right triangle PQM:
QM² + PM² = PQ²
QM² + 16² = 34²
QM² + 256 = 1156
QM² = 900
QM = 30

Answer: 30
